match.pattern: ^Chain (?<chain>\d+) ASIC enumeration failed: found (?<found>\d+) of (?<expected>\d+) chips; hashboard disabled$

rules.title: Chain {{chain}} not detected
rules.summary: {{found}} of {{expected}} chips detected. The hashboard is disabled.

steps.title: Check connections
steps.instruction: With power isolated, follow the approved cable inspection procedure for Chain {{chain}}.

steps.title: Retest the miner
steps.instruction: After the approved checks, restart and read the logs again.

match.pattern: ^Chain (?<chain>\d+) chip temperature (?<temperature>\d+) C exceeds limit (?<limit>\d+) C; thermal protection activated$

rules.title: Chain {{chain}} temperature limit exceeded
rules.summary: Chip temperature is {{temperature}} C, above the {{limit}} C limit. Thermal protection has stopped mining.

steps.title: Follow the thermal shutdown procedure
steps.instruction: Follow your site's approved shutdown and cooldown procedure. Keep thermal protection enabled.

steps.title: Check the cooling conditions
steps.instruction: Have an authorized technician check airflow, ventilation, and cooling for Chain {{chain}} under the approved site procedure. Isolate power before physical inspection.

steps.title: Confirm temperature recovery
steps.instruction: After the approved checks and cooldown, restart under the site procedure and verify that temperatures remain within the approved operating range and the error does not return.

match.pattern: ^Fan (?<fan>\d+) speed (?<rpm>\d+) RPM below minimum (?<minimum>\d+) RPM; fan lost, mining stopped$

rules.title: Fan {{fan}} speed below minimum
rules.summary: Fan {{fan}} reports {{rpm}} RPM, below the {{minimum}} RPM minimum. Mining has stopped because of the fan fault.

steps.title: Power down safely
steps.instruction: Follow your site's approved shutdown and power isolation procedure before inspecting Fan {{fan}}.

steps.title: Check the fan and its connection
steps.instruction: Have an authorized technician inspect Fan {{fan}} and its connection under the approved maintenance procedure. Follow that procedure for any repair or replacement; keep fan protection enabled.

steps.title: Verify fan recovery
steps.instruction: After the approved checks, restart under the site procedure. Confirm Fan {{fan}} meets the approved speed requirement and the fan fault does not return.

rules.title: Pool {{pool}} disconnected
rules.summary: The pool connection was interrupted: {{reason}}. The miner is attempting to reconnect.

steps.title: Check network connectivity
steps.instruction: Follow your site's approved network checks for the miner and pool connection.

steps.title: Check pool settings and availability
steps.instruction: Verify the configured pool address, port, and worker settings under the approved site procedure.

steps.title: Confirm the connection recovers
steps.instruction: Read the logs again and verify that the pool connection is restored and accepted shares resume.

match.pattern: ^PSU voltage abnormal: (?<voltage>\d+(?:\.\d+)?) V; power supply initialization failed$

rules.title: Power supply initialization failed
rules.summary: The PSU reports abnormal voltage of {{voltage}} V. Power supply initialization failed.

steps.title: Power down safely
steps.instruction: Follow your site's approved shutdown and power isolation procedure.

steps.title: Request an authorized power check
steps.instruction: Have an authorized technician inspect the supply and external connections under the approved site procedure. Do not open the PSU.

steps.title: Verify power recovery
steps.instruction: After the approved checks or repair, restart under the site procedure and read the logs again. Confirm the PSU fault does not return.

match.pattern: ^Fault conditions cleared; miner resumed normal operation$

recoveryRules.title: Miner resumed normal operation
recoveryRules.summary: The simulator reports that fault conditions have cleared.
